content: Following the approach similar to BIBREF0 , we limit this bias evaluation to a set of gender-neutral occupations. We create a list of sentences based on a set of templates. There are two sets of templates used for evaluating causal occupation bias (Table TABREF7 ). The first set of templates is designed to measure how the probabilities of occupation words depend on the gender information in the seed. Below is an example of the first set of templates: INLINEFORM0
